description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewDao class responsible for data access related to performance reviews within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It contains methods for creating, updating, fetching, deleting, and managing performance review entities, reviewer relationships, KPI associations, and filters specific to employee performance reviews.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDao
classes.description: This class provides data access methods for managing performance review entities, including CRUD operations, reviewer and KPI management, and filtering functionalities specific to employee performance evaluations.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees and supervisors based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees and supervisors matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds the query for retrieving employee-supervisor relationships based on filters.

methods.name: createReview
methods.description: Creates a new performance review, associating reviewers based on the provided performance review object and reviewer employee number.

methods.name: saveReviewer
methods.description: Saves a reviewer for a specific performance review, assigning the reviewer group and related employee.

methods.name: saveReviewerRating
methods.description: Creates reviewer ratings for each KPI associated with a performance review.

methods.name: getEditableReviewById
methods.description: Fetches a performance review by ID that is in inactive status, suitable for editing.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewById
methods.description: Retrieves a performance review by its ID.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Returns a list of performance reviews based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of performance reviews matching the search filters.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds the query for retrieving performance reviews based on complex filters.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Returns the current self-review status for a given performance review.

methods.name: updateReview
methods.description: Updates an existing performance review, replacing reviewer assignments.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviewReviewers
methods.description: Deletes reviewer entries associated with a performance review.

methods.name: getSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Retrieves supervisor-reportTo records for subordinate and supervisor IDs.

methods.name: getReviewKPI
methods.description: Fetches KPI objects associated with a specific performance review.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the self-reviewer record for a given performance review.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviews
methods.description: Deletes multiple performance reviews by their IDs.

methods.name: getReviewById
methods.description: Fetches a performance review entity by ID.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceReviewIds
methods.description: Checks which review IDs already exist in the database from a provided list.

methods.name: getKpisForReview
methods.description: Retrieves KPIs associated with a specific review, filtered by reviewer group.

methods.name: getKpisForReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of KPIs for a specific review filtered by criteria.

methods.name: getKpisForReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds the query for fetching KPIs related to a review with specific filters.

methods.name: savePerformanceReview
methods.description: Persists a performance review entity, saving it to database.

methods.name: setReviewerStatusToCompleted
methods.description: Sets the status of reviewer records to completed for a specific review.

methods.name: getReviewIdsForSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves review IDs assigned to a supervisor reviewer, excluding inactive reviews and purged records.

methods.name: getPurgeEmployeeReviewIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of performance reviews associated with purged employees.

methods.name: getReviewIdList
methods.description: Returns list of all active performance review IDs.

methods.name: getSelfReviewIds
methods.description: Returns list of performance review IDs for a specific employee with optional status filtering.

methods.name: getReviewerRating
methods.description: Fetches reviewer ratings for a supervisor's evaluation based on filter parameters and group name.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts reviewer ratings based on filter parameters and group name.

methods.name: getEvaluationRatingQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds the query for reviewer ratings during supervisor evaluation.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForReviewId
methods.description: Fetches KPI IDs linked to a specific review.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForJobTitleId
methods.description: Fetches KPI IDs associated with a particular job title.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewerRatings
methods.description: Saves or updates a batch of reviewer ratings, minimizing database operations.

methods.name: getReviewerRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a reviewer entity for a specific review and reviewer group.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of reviewers belonging to a specific group for a performance review.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the comment for a reviewer in a performance review.
